subtitles.zh: 但专家仍看到这些波动之下的机会。
subtitles.en: But experts still see opportunities beneath this office.

subtitles.zh: 那么现在在印度，你应该把一千万卢比配置到哪里？
subtitles.en: So where should you invest one crore rupees in India right now?

subtitles.zh: 我们询问了四位专家，听听他们怎么说。

subtitles.zh: 专家普遍以印度为核心。他们看好大盘和中盘公司，并选择性配置小盘股，

subtitles.en: But some warn against chasing markets after they have already searched.

subtitles.zh: 一位专家建议在三到四个月内分批配置，而不是一次性全部投入。
subtitles.en: One expert suggests staggering investments over three to four months, rather than committing everything at once.
